gdpPerCapita.note: asOf 2025. GDP 144,713,236,540 2011 int$ (World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD x 0.8005) / population 6,549,143 = 22,097. Range +/-10%. Corrected 2026-10-29: values x1.0376 because the rebase factor was an arithmetic error (0.8005); the right factor is 0.8306 (FRED GDPDEF, 2017=100: 2011 91.478 / 2021 110.130). Figures quoted above are before the correction.

gdp.note: asOf 2025. World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD (constant 2021 int$) 180,778,559,076 x 0.8005 (US GDP deflator 2011/2021) = 144,713,236,540 2011 int$. Range +/-10% for PPP benchmark uncertainty and the relative-price drift the rebase ignores. Corrected 2026-10-29: values x1.0376 because the rebase factor was an arithmetic error (0.8005); the right factor is 0.8306 (FRED GDPDEF, 2017=100: 2011 91.478 / 2021 110.130). Figures quoted above are before the correction.

milSpendShare.note: SIPRI via World Bank MS.MIL.XPND.GD.ZS: 2.76% of GDP in 2025 (mid), 2.67% in 2024, 2.73% in 2021. Low is the lowest of those years; high allows ~5% for NATO-definition spending above SIPRI.

industrialShare.note: asOf 2025: industry incl. construction 22.3% of GDP (NV.IND.TOTL.ZS). Range +/-1.5 pp for year-to-year variation.

foodSurplus.note: Recomputed 2026-10-29 under the definition: 0.25 -> 0.86. Formula: surplus = 1 - a/s, a = farm population share of consumers (proxy: agricultural employment share, World Bank SL.AGR.EMPL.ZS, ILO modelled, https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/SRB/indicator/SL.AGR.EMPL.ZS), s = domestic production / consumption (calorie self-sufficiency). a = 18.03% (2025). s from FAOSTAT Food Balance Sheets (https://bulks-faostat.fao.org/production/FoodBalanceSheets_E_All_Data.zip): production / domestic supply summed over all FBS items, each weighted by kcal per tonne (world median of food kcal / food tonnes per item); feed, processing and non-food uses stay in domestic supply. s = 1.33 (mean 2021-2023, range 1.13-1.45). Mid 1 - 0.180/1.33 = 0.86. Low: a x 1.3 (farm households larger than the employed count), s 1.13 = 0.79. High: s 1.45 = 0.88. Net exporter: production is about 133% of domestic calorie supply. Earlier net-trade reading: Educated guess. Net exporter of maize, fruit.

annualCohort.note: asOf 2025. Males reaching military age per year = male population 3,104,218 (SP.POP.TOTL.MA.IN) x share of males aged 15-19 5.261% (SP.POP.1519.MA.5Y) / 5 = 32,663. Males only (conscript-pool convention); about double if women are counted. Range +/-10%.

artillery.note: Educated guess. Yugoimport-SDPR Nora B-52 and MLRS. (context page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_equipment_of_the_Serbian_Armed_Forces)

railKm.note: asOf 2021: 3,348 route-km (IS.RRS.TOTL.KM). Low allows for closures since.

majorPorts.note: Landlocked; Danube river ports only (CIA Factbook).

merchantTonnage.note: Educated guess. Landlocked; Danube river fleet only.

draftAnimals.note: Educated guess. Horses, mules and donkeys, not from FAO data. Militarily irrelevant in 2026.

nuclearWarheads.note: Non-nuclear-weapon state (NPT); FAS Status of World Nuclear Forces 2026 lists only nine nuclear-armed states. FAS lists the five US B61 host states (Belgium, Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Turkey); this state is not one of them.

homeDefense.note: Rubric 1.2: mountainous south, familiar terrain, strong population support.

notes: Modern snapshot, asOf 2025 World Bank data with an Oct 2026 order of battle. Population convention: World Bank Serbia excluding Kosovo, matching ne:SRB. Money in 2011 int$ via derived:ppp-rebase-2011. Force counts from the Wikipedia Serbian Armed Forces equipment list (operational equipment, reserve stocks excluded) and active Serbian military aircraft list; drones = Group 2+ only. Infantry P-role splits are educated guesses (grade D). Landlocked: ships tech describes river craft only.
